sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    CodeVazeiat,
    COUNT(*) AS TedadFaktor,
    SUM(MablaghKolFaktor) AS SumMablaghKolFaktor
FROM Sales.DarkhastFaktor
WHERE Sal = 1405
  AND TarikhFaktor >= '2026-08-23'
  AND TarikhFaktor < '2026-09-23'
GROUP BY CodeVazeiat

request: Three dist center with highest sales in year 1405
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT df.ccMarkazPakhsh, mp.NameMarkazPakhsh, COUNT_BIG(*) AS InvoiceCount, SUM(df.MablaghKolFaktor) AS GrossRial, SUM(df.MablaghKhalesFaktor) AS NetRial, SUM(df.SumMaliat) AS TaxRial FROM Sales.DarkhastFaktor AS df LEFT JOIN Global.MarkazPakhsh AS mp ON mp.ccMarkazPakhsh = df.ccMarkazPakhsh WHERE df.Sal = 1405 AND df.CodeVazeiat IN (6,7,8) GROUP BY df.ccMarkazPakhsh, mp.NameMarkazPakhsh), t AS (SELECT SUM(GrossRial) AS TotalAll FROM c) SELECT TOP (5) c.ccMarkazPakhsh, c.NameMarkazPakhsh, c.InvoiceCount, c.GrossRial, c.NetRial, c.TaxRial, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.GrossRial DESC) AS SalesRank, ROUND(100.0 * c.GrossRial / t.TotalAll, 2) AS PctOfYearTotal FROM c CROSS JOIN t ORDER BY c.GrossRial DESC

request: با توجه به فروش فروردین 1405 تا مهر 1405، بهم بگو فروش آبان رو چه مقدار می بینی؟ فروش کل منظورم هست

SELECT TOP (5)
  SUM(sat.MablaghForosh) AS SumMablaghForosh,
  SUM(sat.MablaghForoshKhalesKala) AS SumMablaghForoshKhalesKala,
  SUM(sat.MablaghTakhfifFaktor) AS SumMablaghTakhfifFaktor,
  SUM(sat.Maliat) AS SumMaliatSatr,
  SUM(sat.Avarez) AS SumAvarez,
  COUNT_BIG(*) AS TedadSatr
FROM Sales.DarkhastFaktorSatr AS sat
INNER JOIN Sales.DarkhastFaktor AS df ON df.ccDarkhastFaktor = sat.ccDarkhastFaktor
WHERE df.Sal = 1405 AND df.CodeVazeiat IN (6,7,8) AND df.TarikhFaktor >= '2026-09-23' AND df.TarikhFaktor < '2026-10-23'
